description: Systems are not regularly scanned for security vulnerabilities using automated tools. This signal indicates that known vulnerabilities in systems, applications, or configurations may exist without being identified.
applicability: Applicable to all networked systems, applications, and infrastructure components. Includes network vulnerability scanning, web application scanning, container image scanning, and cloud configuration assessment.

metadata.detection_notes: Detected through review of vulnerability scanning schedules, scanner configurations, scan coverage reports, and remediation tracking.
